sources.note: Reverse engineering help page; WebFetch extraction (paraphrase)

claims.statement: The Entities from DB dialog lets the user select which database schema to reverse engineer.
claims.supports: Select which database schema you want to reverse engineer
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the SURFACE equivalent: the panel's Schema selector lists the schemas qualifying the tables of the chosen SQL file and filters the relations (unit test reverse_inventory_* and the Designer browser check). Not checked: schemas of a live database.

claims.statement: A 'Use table schema' option writes the schema explicitly into generated @Table annotations.
claims.supports: Use table schema: explicitly specify the database schema in @Table
